title: Redemption in Christ
definition: Redemption in Christ is His saving work by which He purchases and frees sinners from bondage through His blood.
summary: Christ redeems sinners from sin, guilt, bondage, and judgment.
christFocus: Jesus is the Redeemer who gives Himself to purchase people for God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Redemption means release through payment. Scripture teaches that sinners are enslaved to sin and unable to free themselves.

Christ redeems not with silver or gold but with His precious blood. He purchases His people and frees them for God.

Redemption is both deliverance from bondage and belonging to a new Master. Those redeemed by Christ are called to live for Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often think freedom means self-rule. Redemption in Christ matters because true freedom comes from being purchased out of bondage and belonging to God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as one redeemed by Christ. Do not return willingly to the bondage from which He bought you.
